definitions.explanation: A spiny marine animal whose gonads (roe) are considered a delicacy in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: うにの{寿司|すし}が{好|す}きだ。
{新鮮|しんせん}なうにを{食|た}べた。
{北海道|ほっかいどう}はうにの{産地|さんち}として{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: Hokkaido is famous as a sea urchin producing region.

notes:
うに refers to both the sea urchin animal and its edible roe. In food contexts, it specifically means the gonads, prized as a delicacy.

WRITING:
Several kanji exist: {雲丹|うに} (processed/salted roe), {海胆|うに} or {海栗|うに} (the animal). Hiragana うに is standard in most contexts.

COMMON DISHES:
- うに{丼|どん}: sea urchin rice bowl
- うに{軍艦|ぐんかん}{巻|ま}き: sea urchin battleship sushi
- うにパスタ: sea urchin pasta
- うにの{刺身|さしみ}: raw sea urchin

CULTURAL NOTE:
Considered one of the top sushi toppings alongside まぐろ (tuna) and いくら (salmon roe). {北海道|ほっかいどう} is especially famous for high-quality うに. Fresh うに is expensive; the best varieties can cost several thousand yen per piece at sushi restaurants.
